name: universe-expansion-2026-10-17
features: basic seven; no weekly, supply/demand or rotation inputs
selection: Equal-weight common 26-symbol validation net return, 2021-2023; best checkpoint per seed retained; post-update endpoint also reported.
hypothesis: Adding 33 stocks to training improves temporal validation behavior on the same original 26 tradables. Each arm uses the same raw snapshot; its own normalizer fits only its training panel.
survivorship: Retrospective survivor expansion; not a historical-index study. Current sectors are annotations only. No failed-stock or delisting claim.
stopping: Six fixed 50k cells only after CPU smoke and data acceptance. No outcome-driven longer runs or reward changes. All allocations share the existing 150-unit project ceiling and 130-unit stop, with two-hour per-session deadlines.
alpaca: Separate 2016-2023 SIP coverage audit only; incomplete corporate-action evidence blocks substitution into this dividend-aware comparison.
